signature.name: VTask.prod
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {M : Type v} -> {M₂ : Type w} -> {M₃ : Type y} -> [Semiring R] -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [AddCommMonoid M₂] -> [AddCommMonoid M₃] -> [Module R M] -> [Module R M₂] -> [Module R M₃] -> (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) -> (g : M →ₗ[R] M₃) -> M →ₗ[R] M₂ × M₃

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total construction with no junk-value or boundary conventions; it is well-defined for all linear maps f and g sharing the same domain module.

facts.statement: example : VTask.prod (LinearMap.id : (Fin 2 → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (Fin 2 → ℤ)) LinearMap.id 0 = (0, 0) := by decide

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (M M₂ M₃ : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) (g : M →ₗ[R] M₃) (x y : M), VTask.prod f g (x + y) = VTask.prod f g x + VTask.prod f g y
